content.what_it_is: MATLAB parameter-definition function for the FUNWAVE-TVD wave_coherence spectrum generator (WKDATA2D): defines all spectral/wavemaker constants used by Coherence_Spectrum.m and companions, then persists its whole workspace with save inputs.mat (L35). Parameters: mfreq=1125 frequencies, mcomponent=mfreq components, mtheta=25 directions (L3-L5); Hmo=1 m, fp=0.1 Hz, fmax=0.25 Hz, fmin=0.04 Hz, TMA peak-enhancement gamma_spec=5, theta_mean=0 degrees, sigma_theta=10*pi/180 rad directional spreading (L7-L13); wavemaker depth=8 m, g=9.81 (L15-L16); phase_include=1 to embed random phases in the wavemaker text file rather than letting FUNWAVE choose (L18-L20); Coherent_Percentage=100 of components coherent (L24), clamped to [0,100] (L27-L31); theta_mean rounded to one decimal via 0.1*round(theta_mean*10) (L33).
entities: Get_Inputs — function with no arguments and no return; side effect: writes inputs.mat (L1, L35)
mcomponent — number of wave components, = mfreq (L4)
theta_mean — mean direction in degrees, rounded to 1 decimal (L12, L33)
phase_include — flag to include random phase in the input text file (L20)
Coherent_Percentage — percentage of coherent components, clamped 0..100 (L24, L27-L31)

equations.ref: rounding mean direction to one decimal digit

unresolved: save inputs.mat (L35) saves the function's local workspace; consumers (Coherence_Spectrum.m) load it wholesale, creating an implicit interface — any variable rename here silently breaks them.
The clamp branch (L27-L31) is dead code for the hardcoded Coherent_Percentage=100; it only matters if a user edits the value.
mtheta=25, fmax, fmin, phase_include are defined but not used inside this file; their consumption is in sibling scripts not visible here.
The comment 'Twin percentage' (L26) uses different terminology than 'Coherent_Percentage'; the relationship between twin/coherent naming is not explained.
